title: x64dbg delegated-scope map
description: Maps each MCP tool name to the delegated scope required to call it, for the x64dbg delegation proxy.

service.description: Service slug that receipts must carry in their `service` claim.

unmappedPolicy.description: What to do with a tools/call whose name is not in `tools`. Must be deny for fail-closed behavior.

specialDispositions.description: Documentation for tools that need explicit handling beyond a plain scope (catch-all risks).

tools.description: Tool name -> required scope (string) or a disposition object.
